_source: RECONSTRUCTION 5.1, 9.1, 13 and 15: everything the original built but never wired into play (dead data kept in memory, a cycle and a cross nothing ever started, loaded art nothing ever drew). Nothing in Core or Runtime reads this file for behaviour; it exists only so the rebuild keeps every one of these, as data, the way U.VAN-US-A16 asks (owner 2026-10-23).

segmentAtlas._about: MapEditor\maps1.png (RECONSTRUCTION 5.1): the source image segments.json's eleven definitions cut their rectangles from. Parsed by the original's editor and never drawn; kept here as the asset the definitions describe.

ledges._about: World\Map\Map.cs's Ledge[16] (RECONSTRUCTION 5): sixteen slots of up to sixteen Vector2 nodes each, allocated by the constructor and filled by nothing; no code ever reads, draws, collides with or saves a ledge. Kept as the shape the original allocated, not as content (the original never put any in).

sun._about: World\Sun.cs (RECONSTRUCTION 9.1, defect 12): a day-night tint cycle whose Timer only advances inside UpdateTimer, which nothing calls, so the cycle is frozen and both tints stay (0,0,0,0), invisible. Kept inert as data (BIBLE defect 12); nothing in Core or Runtime ticks it.

actionCross._about: Gui\ActionCross.cs (RECONSTRUCTION 9.1, defect 12): a 145x145 glass and frame with four 48x48 icon slots; its construction, update and draw are commented out in GuiManager, and SetActionIcons is an empty shell, so it never exists at runtime. Kept inert as data (BIBLE defect 12). blankIcon is Content\Textures\blank.png (RECONSTRUCTION 13), a 1x1 the original drew the three empty slots with.

portraits._about: Gui\Portraits (RECONSTRUCTION 9.1, 13): seven portraits loaded by the original; Portrait.cs's photo never changes with the selected player, so only portrait_1 (hud.json) is ever drawn. The other six are kept as unused content.

icons._about: Gui\Icons (RECONSTRUCTION 13, defect 14): four action buttons and twenty-nine skill icons, all loaded by the original and none drawn (the ActionCross they belong to never exists). The original's icon_poisondart loaded icon_parry.png's file (a typo) and icon_consecrate.png was never loaded at all; fixed in this data, each name is its own file. icon_regen.png and icon_pray.png are the original's own files and are pixel-for-pixel identical (not a copy mistake like poisondart's); the original's art simply reused one picture for both.

areaLayers._about: Areas (RECONSTRUCTION 5, 13): area_1 is the backdrop grid.json's draw.layers draws; the four parallax images beside it (evidently back and front layers) are in the content project and were never loaded by the original. Kept here as inventory, still undrawn.

particles._about: Particles (RECONSTRUCTION 13): five particle pictures with no particle system in either copy of the project; the Particles folder in the content project is empty of code.

selectors._about: Selectors (RECONSTRUCTION 13): five selector-ring sizes, loaded by nothing (the map editor's own selector is TilePalette's square_selector, editor.json).

banners._about: Banners (RECONSTRUCTION 13): fifteen banner pictures, loaded by nothing.

spriteSheets._about: SpriteSheets (RECONSTRUCTION 13): sixteen character sheets; RandomSkin() names six soldier variants but is never called, and nothing else loads any of these.

unwiredCharacterArt._about: Characters\Playable\Richter (RECONSTRUCTION 13): idle and run strips, never loaded by the original (unlike Shanoa and Leo, whose sheets the original loaded though unused; this rebuild already made Shanoa and Leo playable in characters.json, owner decision U.VAN-T25). Richter has no character entry in characters.json and stays unwired.

orphanCharacterArt._about: Characters\Playable\Untitled.png (768x64) and Characters\frame_10.png (640x64) (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): two more idle/run strips beside Richter's, never loaded by the original and never wired to any character. Kept at Resources/Characters as the original's own files.

textures._about: Content\Textures (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): the pictures beside the ones already drawn or kept above (menu1, console1, cursor, red and blank). white is a second 1x1, loaded but undrawn; brick, console2, foggy_woods and metal1 are loaded but never drawn; block and menu2 are never loaded at all. This folder's block.png is the original's own second picture of that name: kept at Resources/Gui/block, distinct from MapEditor\block.png (Resources/World/block, see mapEditorArt below).

hudMockups._about: Gui\Hud (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): bar_health (135x17) is loaded like the rest of Hud but never drawn, since no health bar is ever shown; demo_gui, demo_gui_0, gui_0 and gui_1 (800x600 each) are mock-up screens built into the content project but never loaded by the original at all.

mapEditorArt._about: MapEditor (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): block.png (76x76) and cell.png (16x16) sit beside maps1 (segmentAtlas, above) and null (Content\Textures\blank.png, drawn as the editor's outline and fills, kept as content.json's actionCross.blankIcon). null and cell are the only two of this folder ever drawn (cell as the debug box); block is loaded but never drawn. Kept at Resources/World/cell and Resources/World/block.

application._about: Content\Application\GameThumbnail.png (64x64) (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): the ClickOnce installer's icon, loaded by the deployment manifest rather than the game's own content pipeline, and never drawn in-game. Kept at Resources/Gui as the original's own file.

fonts._about: Content\Fonts (RECONSTRUCTION 13, U.VAN-US-A17): the three .spritefont descriptors the original built; each names a system font the content pipeline rasterised into a bitmap font at build time, so no binary font file ships (player.json/hud.json/console.json/menu.json already carry Arial's and Lucida Console's point sizes as settings data). All three are loaded; Arial writes every HUD and console line, Lucida Console writes menu items, and Webdings is loaded but never used for any text.
